# Plan and Implement

## Change Summary

Restored the schema-3 to schema-4 save migration so missing `animal.reserve_g` is reconstructed from serialized adult and juvenile shrimp biomass instead of loading legacy colonies with zero reserve. I updated `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs` to seed that retained organic-matter pool while still letting the new shrimp routing parameters come from serde defaults, and I replaced the old zero-reserve save-load regression in `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs` with a biomass-based reserve assertion.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the current schema-3 to schema-4 migration path and legacy save-load regression to confirm that missing `animal.reserve_g` was still being left at the serde default instead of being reconstructed from shrimp biomass.
2. [Completed] Patched `crates/tank_core/src/save.rs` so the v3→v4 migration seeds missing reserve from serialized adult and juvenile shrimp counts, and updated the migration comments to document why reserve cannot stay at zero after upgrade.
3. [Completed] Updated `crates/tank_core/tests/save_load.rs` to assert biomass-based reserve reconstruction for migrated schema-3 saves, then ran formatting and validation to confirm the migration and full `tank_core` suite still pass.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo fmt --all` passed.
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load` passed (19 tests), including `legacy_schema_v3_saves_seed_reserve_from_existing_shrimp_biomass`.
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed in full across lib and integration suites.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` failed only because the unrelated untracked `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs` module has unused imports in the current workspace state.

## Outstanding Risks

- Schema-3 reserve seeding remains heuristic: legacy saves do not store the true retained reserve history, so the migration can only reconstruct `reserve_g` from serialized shrimp biomass.
- `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` is not green in the current workspace because the unrelated untracked module `crates/tank_core/src/budget_helpers.rs` has unused imports; I left that file untouched.
- The pre-existing untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains in the worktree and was left untouched.
